transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. I'm here because I've been feeling completely overwhelmed by constant, distressing worries about germs and contamination. It has gotten so bad that I feel forced to wash my hands over and over again just to try and feel clean.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports persistent, distressing worries about germs and contamination, along with compulsive handwashing behavior. These are hallmark symptoms of Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder. No other conditions from the allowed list better account for the specific combination of obsessions (fear of contamination) and compulsions (repetitive handwashing). Previous Candidates were not provided, but based on this initial presentation, Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder is the most accurate diagnosis.
